procedures.name: Engine Oil Change
procedures.description: Complete engine oil and filter replacement procedure for CFM56 engines
procedures.toolsRequired: Standard wrench set (17mm, 19mm), oil filter wrench, torque wrench
procedures.safetyWarning: ⚠️ CRITICAL: Engine must cool minimum 30 minutes. Improper torque can cause oil leakage.

steps.instruction: Close fuel valve and shut down all engines
steps.safetyWarning: ⚠️ CRITICAL: Ensure engine is completely cooled before proceeding. Wait minimum 30 minutes.
steps.expectedResult: All engines shut down, fuel valve closed

steps.instruction: Locate oil drain plug beneath engine (starboard side)
steps.expectedResult: Oil begins draining into pan - approximately 8 liters will drain

steps.instruction: Remove old oil filter and clean mounting surface thoroughly
steps.safetyWarning: ⚠️ Oil may be hot even after cooling - use protective gloves
steps.expectedResult: Old filter removed, mounting surface clean and dry

steps.instruction: Install new oil filter with gasket lubrication
Fill engine with correct oil grade (Mobil Jet Oil II)
steps.expectedResult: Oil level within acceptable range (between MIN and MAX markings)
steps.safetyWarning: Use only approved aviation oil - DO NOT use automotive oil

steps.instruction: Close oil drain plug and torque to specification
steps.expectedResult: Drain plug torqued correctly - no leaks

steps.instruction: Start engine and check for oil leaks
steps.safetyWarning: ⚠️ Clear area before starting. Be alert for any abnormal sounds.
steps.expectedResult: Engine starts smoothly, no oil leaks visible

procedures.name: Brake System Inspection - AMM 32-41-00
procedures.description: Complete hydraulic brake system functional and visual inspection per AMM 32-41-00. Includes fluid level check, line inspection, and operational testing.
procedures.toolsRequired: Fluid level checker, pressure test kit, inspection mirrors
procedures.safetyWarning: ⚠️ Brake failure can cause catastrophic consequences. All work per TSM 32-41-00. Pressure test mandatory.

steps.instruction: Park aircraft on level floor with landing gear extended (use support stands per TSM 40-00-00)
steps.safetyWarning: MANDATORY: Install certified gear support stands. Do not proceed without positive landing gear locking confirmation

steps.instruction: Inspect brake fluid level in reservoir
Check brake lines for cracks or leaks

procedures.name: Landing Gear Service - AMM 32-12-00
procedures.description: Complete landing gear inspection, lubrication, and functional check per AMM 32-12-00 (SRM Appendix B). Includes structural inspection and pin replacement per schedule.

steps.instruction: Extend landing gear and position aircraft on level surface with certified support stands (CMM 32-12-07)
steps.safetyWarning: CRITICAL SAFETY: Per SRM 32-12, support load must be 1.5x Maximum Landing Weight (MLW). Installation failure = catastrophic landing gear collapse

steps.instruction: Inspect all gear fasteners for proper torque
Apply recommended lubricant to pivot points

components.name: Engine Oil Filter
components.description: Hydraulic oil filter for main engine system
components.maintenance: Replace every 100 flight hours or annually

components.name: Hydraulic Pump
components.material: Cast aluminum body with steel gears
components.maintenance: Check flow and pressure every 50 flight hours

safety.warning: Do not disconnect hydraulic lines under pressure
safety.procedure: All pressurized connections must be relieved before disconnection
safety.consequence: Serious injury from high-pressure fluid spray
safety.prevention: Use proper depressurization procedures per manual

safety.warning: Never work on landing gear without proper support
safety.procedure: Use certified landing gear stands before maintenance
safety.prevention: Always place support stands before any work

safety.warning: Engine oil is extremely hot after operation
safety.prevention: Use proper PPE and wait for cooling

tools.description: Digital torque wrench for fastener tightening - 0-200 Nm range

tools.name: Oil Filter Wrench
tools.description: Adjustable wrench for oil filter removal

tools.name: Landing Gear Stands
tools.description: Heavy-duty aluminum stands for gear support

diagnostics.cause: Hydraulic system rupture or seal failure
diagnostics.solution: Do not operate aircraft. Locate leak source and replace damaged component.
steps: Identify leak location from blue fluid trail
Replace damaged hose or reseal connection

diagnostics.cause: Low brake fluid or pressure loss
diagnostics.solution: Check system and top up as needed
steps: Look for visible leaks in brake lines
If problem persists, consult full manual
